race.comment: DOUBLE NEEDS (3) should find this easier than his last attempt in a Breeders Challenge Blue heat. He has claims off a placing from a wider barrier three back at this circuit and distance. RUBATEEKI (2) did a good job to come from a back row draw and finish third last start, beaten 5.6 metres at Bathurst.. Expected to run well aided by a good draw. VESPA STRIDE (7) is in the mix following a solid effort for fifth at his most recent appearance from the back row at Penrith. JANELLE MAY (1) has been back to the trials since breaking last start. The inside draw gives her every chance to show her best.
